body.statement: For fixed rational \((p_x,r_{0,x},r_{1,x},\Gamma_A,\Gamma_0,\Gamma_1)\) with interior observed cells and finite budgets, \(\mathsf{CERT}\) terminates and returns exact real-algebraic representations, rational isolating intervals, and exact membership certificates for \(\ell_x\) and \(\upsilon_x\).  Its candidate list is exhaustive over both exposure-odds boundary arcs and their endpoints, every legal analytic outcome-sign branch, and all interior stationary points.  It neither admits a cleared-denominator artifact nor omits a legal root, and it handles separately \(\Gamma_A=1\), \(\Gamma_a=1\), constant-\(U\) corners, root collisions, and positive-dimensional stationary continua.  This fixed-input output is not a symbolic atlas over varying observed summaries or budgets.
body.justification: An exact bound is operational only if every branch and degeneracy has a terminating, auditable certificate.
body.gap: Existing binary-\(U\) analyses use user-selected grids, and modern marginal-sensitivity bounds use convex duality; neither supplies a complete verifier for this algebraic common-law program.
body.consumer: A reproducible implementation can attach exact isolating intervals and branch witnesses to reported sensitivity endpoints.
